title: motor-recomendacion-owa: operador OWA espectral endógeno al perfil para recomendación de portafolios

creators.name: Quintero-Avellaneda, Diego
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Administration, Universidad Nacional de Colombia (National University of Colombia), Manizales Campus

description: Profile-endogenous spectral OWA operator for portfolio recommendation: code, data snapshots, results and figure scripts of the doctoral research of Diego Quintero-Avellaneda (Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Manizales Campus). Version 1.3.1 adds the figure scripts and graphical abstract of the article on risk-order inversion in OWA-based portfolio recommendation.
